name: oqaasileriffik.gl
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds.
lesson: Keep body text at a 4.5:1 contrast ratio or more against its background.
summary: oqaasileriffik.gl scores 65 out of 100 (D). 5 checks fail now, 31 are at risk, and 26 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 91 elements on /, /oqaasileriffik/, /oqaasileriffik/allaffeqarfik/, for example #menu-item-13446 > .uael-has-submenu-container > .uael-menu-item[aria-haspopup="true"] and #menu-item-19401 > .uael-has-submenu-container >…
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 31 elements on /, for example span[aria-label="Go to slide 3"] and span[aria-label="Go to slide 4"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Make tap targets at least 24 by 24 px, or leave that much space around them.

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Analytics (2 requests), Google Ads (2 requests), and cookies _ga_TE77N7CKVT, _ga, _gid, _gat, YSC on youtube.com, VISITOR_INFO1_LIVE on youtube.com.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 22 elements on /, /oqaasileriffik/, /oqaasileriffik/allaffeqarfik/, for example .elementor-element-375e6b83 > .elementor-widget-container > a[href$="oqaasileriffik.gl"] and .elementor-element-1f0311b > .elementor-widget-container > a.…
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
Core Web Vitals pass for real visitors
Language alternates point at each other
